brief_summary: The goal of this clinical trial is to examine the effect plant-based diet, with a partial replacement of animal protein by plant protein, in blood sugar levels and other health risks of people with type 2 diabetes and excessive weight. The plant-based diet will be compared to a standard healthy diet according to guidelines for people with diabetes. Participants will follow a plant-based or a standard healthy diet for 24 weeks and will maintain their habitual levels of physical activity.
brief_title: Effect of Partial Dietary Replacement From Animal to Plant-Based Protein for Type 2 Diabetes Management
collaborators: Conselho Nacional de Desenvolvimento Científico e Tecnológico

lead_sponsor.name: Hospital de Clinicas de Porto Alegre

official_title: Effect of Partial Dietary Replacement From Animal to Plant-Based Protein for Type 2 Diabetes Management: A Randomized Clinical Trial
